french-algeria.title: Flag of French Algeria
desc: - French Algeria (1830–1962) was considered an integral part of France and flew the French tricolour as its official flag
- **Construction:** the French Tricolore served as the official flag during French colonial rule of Algeria
trivia:
- French Algeria was a French colony from 1830 to 1962
- The Union Jack represented French colonial rule
- Algeria's independence war (1954–1962) was particularly brutal

british-palestine.title: Flag of the British Mandate of Palestine

colors.note: The Union Jack; British mandate authority.

desc: - The British Mandate of Palestine (1920–1948) used a Blue Ensign defaced with a circle containing the word "Palestine" in English, Arabic, and Hebrew
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign or Red Ensign defaced with the Mandate of Palestine badge
trivia:
- Palestine was a British mandate from 1920 to 1948 after World War I
- The flag used during this period reflected British administrative authority
- The mandate ended with the establishment of the State of Israel in 1948

french-syria.title: Flag of the French Mandate of Syria
desc:
- The flag of French Mandate Syria featured the French Tricolore with various modifications, including a green cedared design for the separate State of Aleppo and State of Damascus
- Used during France's administration of Syria under the League of Nations mandate (1920–1946), the flag reflected colonial control while incorporating local symbols
- **Construction:** the French Tricolore in vertical format, sometimes defaced with local emblems. Ratio 2:3
trivia:
- Syria was a French mandate from 1920 to 1946 after World War I
- The Union Jack represented French administrative authority
- Syria gained independence in 1946

french-lebanon.title: Flag of the French Mandate of Lebanon
desc:
- The flag of French Mandate Lebanon featured the French Tricolore with a cedar of Lebanon centred on the white stripe
- Used during France's League of Nations mandate (1920–1943), it reflected French colonial authority while incorporating Lebanon's ancient cedar symbol
- The cedar was retained on the independent Lebanese flag adopted in 1943
- **Construction:** the French vertical Tricolore (blue-white-red) with a green cedar centred on the white band. Ratio 2:3
trivia:
- Lebanon was a French mandate from 1920 to 1943 after World War I
- The Union Jack represented French administrative authority
- Lebanon gained independence in 1943

anglo-egyptian-sudan.title: Flag of Anglo-Egyptian Sudan
desc: - The Anglo-Egyptian Sudan (1899–1956) was a condominium using the Union Jack and Egyptian flag together, symbolising joint British-Egyptian rule
- **Construction:** a blue field with the condominium emblem, representing the joint Anglo-Egyptian administration
trivia:
- Sudan was jointly administered by Britain and Egypt from 1899 to 1956
- The flag represents this unique colonial arrangement during the British-Egyptian condominium
- Sudan gained independence in 1956 and adopted its own national flag

italian-somaliland.title: Flag of Italian Somaliland
desc: - Italian Somaliland (1889–1960) used the Italian tricolour, representing Italian colonial rule over southern Somalia
- **Construction:** the Italian tricolour used as the colonial flag, sometimes with a colonial badge
trivia:
- Italian Somaliland was an Italian colony in the Horn of Africa (1889–1960)
- The Union Jack represented Italian colonial rule
- Merged with British Somaliland to form Somalia in 1960

british-somaliland.title: Flag of British Somaliland
desc: - British Somaliland (1884–1960) used a Blue Ensign defaced with a crown badge — representing British rule over northern Somalia
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign with the British Somaliland badge in the fly half
trivia:
- British Somaliland was a British protectorate from 1884 to 1960
- The Union Jack reflected British administration and control
- Merged with Italian Somaliland to form Somalia in 1960
